calculation.description: Cross-sectional demeaned negative five-session return divided by lagged 20-session realized volatility; higher values favor recent losers after risk normalization. All inputs are lagged before the forward test.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through latest available market data at validation

metrics.paper_icir_definition: mean daily cross-sectional IC / standard deviation of daily cross-sectional IC (non-annualized)

validation.regime_notes: Absolute IC exceeded the threshold, but the non-annualized daily paper ICIR did not. The candidate is not admitted. The 15-asset universe and incomplete valid-date coverage warrant conservative interpretation.
